title: Monotonicity of odd majority noise stability
statement: For every correlation parameter $\rho$ with $0<\rho<1$, the noise stability of majority on $2m+1$ coordinates, viewed as a function of $m\in\mathbb{N}$, is antitone: increasing $m$ cannot increase its value.
